title: Resistance: mothers, grandmothers and the Church
goal: I can describe how people resisted repression, using the gerund for two actions at the same time.

items: I can say when and how the Mothers of the Plaza de Mayo began to march.
I can explain what the Grandmothers of the Plaza de Mayo looked for.
I can say what the Vicaría de la Solidaridad did in Chile.
I can use the gerund to say how or while someone acted.
I can use the new words for protest, solidarity and human rights.
